description: Flutter Windows release executables created with affected 3.7/3.10 templates can stay hidden because the first-frame callback is registered too late, based on https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/119415.
prompt: My Flutter Windows release build runs only the first time. After I close it, double-clicking the exe creates processes in Task Manager but no window; debug mode is fine, and renaming the output folder makes it show once again.
